deviations: The interquartile range is computed per property x survey round (match_id x year) over all such cells; the paper's 'at least five members represented' restriction is not applied, because the reported observation counts (327 and 118) equal the number of all property-round cells in the 300 and 150 ha samples (only 128 and 45 cells have five or more surveyed workers).
Percentiles use R quantile type 2 (Stata _pctile/egen pctile definition).
notes: Three exploratory runs (variable listing; sample/cluster/cell counts, no estimates), then one scored run kept as final. Specification: feols(outcome ~ Above500 + norm_dist + Above500:norm_dist | year), uniform kernel, sample |norm_dist| < bandwidth (300 or 150), SEs clustered by former owner (Expropretario_ISTA). Outcome: hh_income_pc (columns 1-2, worker level); within-property-round IQR of hh_income_pc (columns 3-4). Observation, cluster counts and dependent-variable means (73.59, 74.81, 38.63, 37.52) match Table 5 exactly. Point estimates: 82.25, 71.83, -56.42, -63.73 versus claimed 60.49, 52.79, -42.97, -51.79 (same signs, about 1.2-1.4x larger). check_attempt on the scored run reported all claims within tolerance, so the script was not changed. No docker hangs.
